artifact.note: The artifact is the model card the platform publishes and is checksum-addressed. This completion document is stored beside it and never inside it, so every previously published hash remains valid.

identity.name: Lettuce Earth growth · WUR random forest

purpose: Predict fresh shoot mass per lettuce plant from thermal time, air and root-zone temperature and incident PPFD, for a controlled-environment lettuce crop.
intendedUse: Exploring how a change in temperature or light moves per-plant fresh mass inside a plant-factory envelope, and producing a number a researcher can compare against their own measurement.
notIntendedFor: Operational or mission planning: the model fails its own independent check (41.6 % MAPE against a 30 % criterion fixed before the measurement).
Crops, cultivars or light regimes outside the declared domain; the model refuses rather than extrapolating.
Any claim about spaceflight performance. The training data are terrestrial.

trainingData.hashBasis: SHA-256 of data/processed/lettuce_earth.csv exactly as committed, which is the table train_lettuce.py writes and every lettuce trainer reads. Covers 1648 plant rows x 7 columns; the file is deterministic because the transform from the WUR workbook is fixed in the training script.
trainingData.reconstruction: python3 ml/training/train_lettuce.py regenerates the table from the committed workbook.

split.method: Nested leave-one-experiment-out cross-validation (4 outer, 3 inner folds).
split.note: All plants and treatments from an experiment remain in the same fold, so the score measures transfer to an unseen experiment rather than to an unseen row.

uncertainty.statement: 90 % cross-conformal (CV+) interval, radius 112.94 g/plant, measured held-out coverage 0.939 over 4 calibration groups. The artifact records its own caveat: the interval describes this dataset's spread and is not a guarantee for a new greenhouse.

limitations: Tip-burn-related treatment omissions create selection bias.
Plant identifiers are reused across experiments; split by whole experiment.
Only Batavia Othilie lettuce on Earth; not calibrated for partial gravity or radiation.
No inference for water stress, nutrient stress, CO2 response, other cultivars, or different photoperiods.
Measured domain is 2–29 days after transplant, air/root 20–32 C, PPFD 200–750 µmol/m²/s; treatment grid is sparse.
Environmental combinations omitted for tip burn are unsupported even inside marginal ranges.
Fresh shoot mass per plant is not edible harvest per square meter; no planting-density conversion is assumed.

outOfDomainBehaviour.mechanism: The artifact's `domain` block is enforced before scoring; a request outside it is refused with the field and range named rather than extrapolated, and a transcriptomic model rejects a partial expression vector instead of zero-filling.
